title: READABLE HIT REACTIONS PILOT
description: The update spends credibility in one place and tries to earn it back somewhere else. Enemies now stagger, flash, and fall with timing that makes successful hits feel less like clerical work. The upgrade flow now presents higher-value bundles at the exact moment players run out of patience.
consequence: The combat log finally stopped doing all the emotional labor. The economy found the pause between frustration and quitting.

title: READABLE HIT REACTIONS RELIEF
description: The change softens one part of the product while sharpening another part that can be measured. Enemies now stagger, flash, and fall with timing that makes successful hits feel less like clerical work. Several paid shortcuts have been moved into baseline progression to reduce accusations of hostage design.
consequence: The combat log finally stopped doing all the emotional labor. Revenue meetings became quieter in the way elevators get quiet.

title: GROUNDED TRAVERSAL PASS PILOT
description: The feature asks players to perform progress for each other before asking whether the progress is good. Jumping, mounting, and rolling now preserve more momentum debt so movement feels heavier and more authored. The upgrade flow now presents higher-value bundles at the exact moment players run out of patience.
consequence: The character moves like they read the physics spec and took it personally. The economy found the pause between frustration and quitting.
